name: comp-180
title: Switch Off On Labels
blurb: Switch with clickable Off/On labels on both sides.
description: Toggle switch flanked by clickable Off and On text labels. Built on shadcn's Switch with state management.
use_when: Clarity on state is paramount and the labels can serve as additional click targets.
avoid_when: Minimalist designs or when space is very constrained.
a11y: Built on accessible Switch primitive with aria-labelledby linking to text labels, and both labels as click targets.
